notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Hibru i gat pasin suffix -הו long ותשליכהו, Tasol Tok Pisin i nidim tok 'em' bilong tok klia

notes.subject: יצרו
notes.rationale: ol save tanim 'i kamap sait' (narapela rot i sot); sampela i ritim olsem strong bilong em i kirap narapela — narapela lain i tanim 'i bagarap'

translation: Ol step bilong strong bilong em i kamap sait, na plan bilong em yet i tromoi ⟨em⟩ i go daun.

tokens.gloss: i tromoi em i go daun
